Re the AU chart. One of the problems I'm having is judging the implications of compression. To my brain those long wicks appearing during the distribution phase of the original H4 infer that should price go long it won't have a problem sailing up through that area. But I may be completely wrong on this.

Another issue I'm having seems to be with Alpari's charts, which the time to CET (GMT -2 hours). It means that I get the occasional funny looking setup. It's even had me go long into a level that looked to me like a speedbump on my charts but on other feeds was a textbook H4 supply level.

A solution to both these issues seems to be wrapping lines around the level of interest and then once price touches, move down to a M1 chart and basically start looking and waiting for the reversal + signals to happen in real time.

Can I ask how you would time a trade like this one because if you see the attached H1 chart of the original level you'll notice that all the candles in the area seem engulfed. The only "fresh" area in the level looks to me to be around 1.0645 and price didn't reach it.

Thanks for your time.
